impasse_procedure.value: Optional mediation, then fact-finding by or through the Education Factfinding Commission, whose recommendations become public if the impasse is not resolved. Not binding.
impasse_procedure.quote: If mediation fails or if mediation is not attempted, the board or representative organization may request that the education factfinding commission provide assistance.

strike_legality.value: Prohibited for teachers and administrators; the school board may withhold wages from strikers. No statute captured addresses other public employees.
strike_legality.quote: Teachers and administrators employed by school districts may not participate in a strike.

agency_fee_status.value: Prohibited. North Dakota's right-to-work statute voids contracts that abridge the right to work for nonmembership, and nonmembers may not be compelled to pay bargaining costs (only grievance costs they request in writing). Janus v. AFSCME (2018) also bars agency fees from nonconsenting public employees.
agency_fee_status.quote: The right of persons to work may not be denied or abridged on account of membership or nonmembership in any labor union or labor organization, and all contracts in negation or abrogation of such rights are hereby declared to be invalid, void, and unenforceable.
